citations.quote: the ability to trade a security quickly at a price close to its consensus value, that is, in the sense of “market liquidity.”

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Liquidity has three interrelated meanings — market liquidity (asset tradability), funding liquidity (intermediaries' access to credit), and monetary liquidity — and funding shocks feed back into market liquidity through liquidity spirals.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: The Three Dimensions of Liquidity: Market, Funding, and Monetary
